simple.meaning: מֻטֶּה (muṭṭeh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a stretching , i.e. distortion (figuratively, iniquity).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 9:9. Its contexts include blood, city, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֻטֶּה (H4297).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
